scope: Manual news reviews for unclassified ≥15% jumps after EDGAR Item 2.02 earnings drops and hard filters (sub-$5, ETF/ETN denylist, no-option). Keep only classes 2/3/4; do not invent keeps for other catalysts.

reviews.detail: Schlumberger VorTeq 15-year licensing agreement announced ~Oct 19 after-close / Oct 20 reaction. Commercial license, not M&A target, biotech trial, or product breakthrough under keep 2/3/4.
Genetic Technologies ASX/6-K: up to six new breast centers to offer BREVAGenplus; product commercialization expansion. Kept as class 4 (tech/product breakthrough), not earnings (no Item 2.02 match).
FDA briefing documents for tasimelteon (Hetlioz) Non-24 disorder painted positive efficacy ahead of advisory panel; class-3 biotech trial/regulatory data reaction.
Positive Phase IIb Kinect 2 results for NBI-98854 (VMAT2) in tardive dyskinesia; statistically significant AIMS reduction vs placebo.
EMA CHMP recommended renewal of Translarna conditional marketing authorization for nmDMD; class-3 clinical/regulatory success for approved therapy.
Phase 3 ITI-007 schizophrenia trial: 60 mg met primary PANSS endpoint vs placebo; 8-K 8.01 same session.
Phase 3 EASE LID: ADS-5102 met primary endpoint reducing levodopa-induced dyskinesia vs placebo.
Repros Therapeutics (historical RPRX, not later Royalty Pharma): Androxal pivotal ZA-301 met both FDA co-primary endpoints. Note: modern cik2symbol may point at wrong CIK.
FDA accelerated approval of eteplirsen (Exondys 51) for DMD exon-51 skipping; first approved DMD therapy.
ASH interim LentiGlobin BB305 data: first four beta-thalassemia major patients with ≥3 months follow-up transfusion-free.
Additional positive Phase 2 OMS721 TMA/aHUS data; company planning Phase 3.
ASCO Phase 1 expansion: mirvetuximab soravtansine 53% ORR in platinum-resistant FRα+ ovarian cancer.
Positive Phase 1 OMS824 (PDE10) schizophrenia data plus Phase 2 initiation; class-3 clinical catalyst.
I-SPY 2: neratinib regimen graduated for HER2+/HR- breast cancer with high Bayesian success probability.
Definitive agreement to acquire ProBuild for ~$1.63B all-cash; 8-K Item 1.01 same session. Acquirer announcement is class-2 M&A news.
Rocket 2 Phase 3 Rhopressa met primary non-inferiority endpoint vs timolol for IOP lowering.
ITT Educational Services preliminary enrollment better than May forecast; operational/enrollment update, not keep 2/3/4. Note cik2symbol may not match historical ITT Educational CIK.
FDA agreed pivotal Phase 3 -020 plus supportive data sufficient for pimavanserin NDA; confirmatory -021 cancelled.
Phase 2 VX-661+ivacaftor combo: statistically significant FEV1 improvements in F508del homozygous CF.
Pivotal Phase 3 TELESTAR: telotristat etiprate met primary endpoint in carcinoid syndrome.
FDA agreed rolling NDA for eteplirsen after pre-NDA meeting; clinical/regulatory path for DMD candidate.
Phase 3 MAGIC: SUSTOL regimen met primary endpoint for delayed CINV after HEC vs standard of care.
Sympathy move with Intercept NASH trial stop-early news; no Galectin company-specific trial success that day (enrollment update came Jan 13).
Pfizer definitive acquisition of Anacor at $99.25/share (~$5.2B). Target M&A announcement.
Repros: FDA meeting — no additional clinical studies required to file Androxal NDA (CV safety interest noted for possible post-approval work).
Two Phase 3 crisaborole atopic dermatitis studies met all primary and secondary endpoints.

Intrexon/ZIOPHARM exclusive CAR-T licensing pact with MD Anderson ($50M stock each). Collaboration/IP license, not M&A of issuer, trial success, or product breakthrough under keep 2/3/4. 8-K Item 1.01 present.
CommonWealth REIT: Corvex/Related 9.8% stake; open letter willing to acquire all shares at premium if board uncooperative. Activist M&A rumor/news. Note: modern cik2symbol may map Camping World.
ExactTarget (then NYSE:ET) acquired by Salesforce for $33.75/share (~$2.5B). Note: cik2symbol currently maps ET to Energy Transfer CIK — wrong issuer for this date.
MKS Instruments definitive all-cash acquisition of Newport at $23/share (~$980M).
Phase 2 Resunab/JBT-101 systemic sclerosis: median CRISS 33% vs 0% placebo (p=0.044).
Scientific Games to acquire WMS Industries for $26/share cash (~$1.5B). Note: modern cik2symbol may map a different WMS issuer.
VisionChina Media revised partial sale of subway ad business stake to Ledman; asset/equity transfer, not keep 2/3/4 M&A-of-issuer / trial / breakthrough.
MOU with Schlumberger to jointly market FLNG/gas monetization solutions; partnership MOU, not keep 2/3/4.
Emergency investor call: CEO reassurances on Ocwen relationship, layoffs, contemplated buyback after regulatory scare. Not keep 2/3/4.
Phase 3 BEMA buprenorphine in opioid-naive chronic pain met primary endpoint; $10M Endo milestone.
FDA written responses: Zilretta registration data acceptable to support NDA filing; NDA planned 4Q16.
FDA agreed to change Rocket 2 primary endpoint IOP range after Rocket 1 subgroup analysis; clinical/regulatory path for Rhopressa.
Phase 3 ExteNET: neratinib adjuvant therapy improved DFS 33% vs placebo in early-stage HER2+ breast cancer; NDA planned 1H15. Extreme print from trial success, not split.
Education Realty Trust 1-for-3 reverse stock split effective Dec 1 2014 8:00am ET. Apparent ~198% close-to-close print is mechanical split artifact, not keep 2/3/4.
Phase 3 Epidiolex (CBD) Dravet syndrome: primary endpoint met; median convulsive seizure reduction 39% vs 13% placebo (p=0.01).
AT&T agreed to acquire Leap Wireless for $15/share cash (~$1.2B) plus Chicago spectrum proceeds. Note: modern cik2symbol may map a different LEAP issuer.
Interim Phase 1 RG-101 HCV: single 2mg/kg SC dose mean 4.1 log10 viral load reduction at day 29; human proof-of-concept for microRNA therapeutic.
CEO interview suggested additional North America automaker order; next day clarified as already-disclosed. Commercial-order chatter, not keep 2/3/4.
Priceline agreed to acquire OpenTable for $103/share cash (~$2.6B). Historical OpenTable ticker OPEN.
Sold Antelope Valley solar projects to MidAmerican/Berkshire for ~$2–2.5B construction/sale contracts. Project sale, not M&A of SunPower / trial / breakthrough keep.
Apollo agreed to acquire ADT for $42/share cash (~$7B equity) and merge with Protection 1.
Sold TransMontaigne GP/IDRs to ArcLight for $350M cash. Asset/GP sale by NGL, not keep 2/3/4 takeout of NGL.
Primary catalyst was raised 2013 guidance far above Street; also announced TetraSun tuck-in. Guidance/outlook not keep 2/3/4.
Phase 2 vadadustat in dialysis CKD anemia: maintained hemoglobin after conversion from rESA; favorable safety.
Comprehensive Bank of America litigation settlement (~$1.6B cash + related terms). Legal settlement, not keep 2/3/4.
Mercury 1 Phase 3 Roclatan met primary endpoint; superior IOP lowering vs each component (Rhopressa and latanoprost).
AbbVie global collaboration on duvelisib ($275M upfront). Partnership/license, not M&A of Infinity as target.
Sanofi/Genzyme bought ~12% stake for $700M and expanded rare-disease RNAi collaboration. Minority stake/partnership, not keep-class takeout.
Volkswagen Truck & Bus $256M investment for 16.6% stake plus strategic alliance. Minority stake/alliance, not definitive takeout of Navistar.
Bayer collaboration/license for two antibody cancer immunotherapies ($10M upfront, >$500M milestones). Partnership/license, not M&A of Compugen, trial readout, or tech breakthrough under keep 2/3/4.
OPEC agreed ~1.2M bpd production cut; oil/E&P sector rally. Commodity/macro move, not keep 2/3/4.
MakeMyTrip agreed to acquire/combine with ibibo Group (Naspers/Tencent) in all-stock deal; Naspers/Tencent become ~40% of MMYT. Acquirer M&A announcement is class-2.

FDA accepted tasimelteon NDA and granted priority review for Non-24 in totally blind; PDUFA 2014-01-31; AdCom tentatively 2013-11-14. Class-3 clinical/regulatory path milestone (8-K 8.01 same session).
Brazil provisional measure raising foreign airline ownership cap 20%→49%; capital-structure/regulatory relief speculation, not keep 2/3/4.
NICE recommended Translarna (ataluren) for ambulatory nmDMD in England under managed-access agreement with NHS. Class-3 clinical/regulatory access success.
Post-election rebound after Trump win; investors priced reversal of Obama DOJ private-prison phase-out. Political/macro, not keep 2/3/4.
CMS granted Omidria transitional pass-through reimbursement status. Commercial/reimbursement catalyst, not trial success, M&A, or tech breakthrough under keep 2/3/4.
Walgreens Boots Alliance agreed to acquire Rite Aid for $9/share cash (~$9.4B equity / $17.2B EV incl. debt); WSJ talks during session, definitive deal same day AH.
FDA granted Arikayce Breakthrough Therapy Designation for treatment-refractory NTM lung disease based on Phase 2 findings; 8-K 8.01 same session. Class-3 clinical/regulatory.
50/50 Stagecoach Gas JV with Con Edison; ConEd pays ~$975M for 50% of Crestwood Northeast pipeline/storage assets, plus distribution cut. Asset JV/stake sale, not takeout of CEQP under keep-2.
Teva definitive tender offer to acquire Auspex Pharmaceuticals at $101/share cash (~$3.5B equity).
Apollo Tyres definitive agreement to acquire Cooper Tire for $35/share cash (~$2.5B).
BELMONT Phase 2 interim: RT002 injectable achieved 100% Week-4 response and statistically superior ~6-month duration vs BOTOX Cosmetic; Phase 3 planned 2H16. 8-K 7.01/8.01 same session.
Renewed 5-year Walmart MoneyCard program agreement plus $150M buyback. Commercial contract renewal (Item 1.01), not M&A takeout/trial/tech under keep 2/3/4.

Array BioPharma (historical ARRY) agreed to acquire worldwide rights to encorafenib (LGX818) from Novartis. In-license/asset transfer, not M&A of Array as target, trial readout, or tech breakthrough. Note: modern cik2symbol may map a different ARRY issuer.
TRAFFIC and TRANSPORT Phase 3: lumacaftor+ivacaftor met primary FEV1 endpoint in F508del homozygous CF; NDA/MAA planned 4Q14.
Phase 3 HBV-23 HEPLISAV-B met co-primary safety and superior seroprotection vs Engerix-B (incl. diabetics); BLA resubmission targeted end-1Q16.
SCA agreed to acquire Wausau Paper (then NYSE:WPP) for $10.25/share cash (~$513M). Note: modern cik2symbol may map WPP Group/other issuer.
Eteplirsen Phase IIb 120-week update: continued 6MWT stabilization; 64.9m treatment benefit vs placebo/natural history framing at JPMorgan.
FDA guidance supporting potential accelerated-approval NDA for eteplirsen by year-end 2014 plus confirmatory study path; 8-K 8.01 same session.
Rejoice Phase 3: TX-004HR vaginal estradiol met all four primary co-endpoints for postmenopausal dyspareunia/VVA; NDA planned 1H16.
First patient enrolled in ORMD-0801 glucose-clamp study; Phase IIb planned. Trial initiation/enrollment, not readout or keep 2/3/4 catalyst.
Avago agreed to acquire LSI Corp for $11.15/share cash (~$6.6B). Note: modern cik2symbol may map a different LSI issuer.
Identiv Cisco IoE/physical access-control partnership (iPAM). Commercial partnership, not keep 2/3/4.
FDA meeting feedback on OTX-TP Phase 3 plan for glaucoma/OHT: placebo-controlled design without timolol arm; first Phase 3 planned 3Q16. Class-3 clinical/regulatory path.
Biogen Idec collaboration/license on ZFP gene editing for sickle cell/beta-thalassemia ($20M upfront, ~$294M milestones). Partnership/license (Item 1.01), not M&A of Sangamo under keep-2.
NJ Gov. Christie conditional support for Atlantic City online gambling legalization; sector-wide gaming rally. Political/regulatory industry catalyst, not keep 2/3/4.
Q3 earnings beat (rev +37%, non-GAAP EPS +62%) plus raised FY guidance; Endicia close timing update. Earnings/guidance reaction (no Item 2.02 auto-drop), not keep 2/3/4.
China MIIT approved Kandi-Geely EV sedan for subsidies/road use. Product regulatory/commercial approval, not M&A, biotech trial, or tech breakthrough under keep 2/3/4.
Phase 2 SAGE-547 severe PPD: primary HAM-D endpoint met at 60h (p=0.008); 70% remission vs placebo; effect maintained to day 30.
Revised AB InBev/Modelo deal: Constellation to buy Piedras Negras brewery and perpetual U.S. Corona/Modelo rights for $2.9B and take full Crown ownership. Acquirer M&A/asset purchase is class-2.
News Corp agreed to acquire Move Inc (realtor.com) for $21/share cash (~$950M).
Jefferies upgrade to Buy plus company call previewing upcoming myeloma plans; STORM Phase 2b top-line reported later (Sep 6). Analyst/upgrade day, not keep 2/3/4 readout.
Terex confirmed unsolicited non-binding Zoomlion proposal at $30/share cash amid pending Konecranes combo. Company-confirmed M&A proposal is class-2.
Tokio Marine definitive agreement to acquire HCC Insurance for $78/share cash (~$7.5B). Note: modern cik2symbol may map a different HCC issuer.
Teledyne definitive agreement to acquire Bolt Technology for $22/share cash (~$171M). Note: modern cik2symbol may map a different BOLT issuer.
CMS final Medicare NCD for Cologuard plus preliminary $502 reimbursement. Coverage/reimbursement for already-approved test, not trial/M&A/tech under keep 2/3/4.
Broad China/ADR rebound after A-share rescue measures (Shanghai +~6%). Macro/sector bounce, not keep 2/3/4.
Coal/commodity sector bounce on weaker USD; Peabody led coal names. Commodity/macro, not keep 2/3/4.
Heavily shorted ITT Educational bounce tied to Cerberus $100M term-loan liquidity relief. Financing/short-squeeze, not keep 2/3/4.
LSB selling Climate Control Business to NIBE for $364M cash to cut debt. Divisional asset sale, not takeout of LXU under keep-2.
Congress agreed to extend solar investment tax credit; broad solar-sector rally. Policy/tax subsidy, not keep 2/3/4.
13D: Alibaba affiliates joined Momo going-private buyer group (CEO Tang proposal). Confirmed privatization/M&A financing news is class-2.
Gannett definitive agreement to acquire Belo for $13.75/share cash (~$1.5B equity / $2.2B EV). Acquirer M&A announcement is class-2. Note: modern cik2symbol may map a different GCI issuer.
Media General all-stock merger with New Young Broadcasting (Young shareholders ~67.5%). Class-2 M&A combination. Note: modern cik2symbol may map a different MEG issuer.
Phase 2a Jakafi+capecitabine in advanced pancreatic cancer: predefined subgroup 6-month survival 42% vs 11% chemo alone.
Leaked/early USPSTF final colorectal screening guidelines including Cologuard (JAMA). Guideline/coverage catalyst, not trial/M&A/tech under keep 2/3/4.
FDA Type C and EMA Rapporteur meetings: accelerate migalastat MAA to 2Q15 full approval path and plan U.S. Subpart H NDA 2H15 for Fabry monotherapy. Class-3 clinical/regulatory.
Coupons.com Q3 earnings: rev +47% to $58.5M, raised FY guidance. Earnings/guidance, not keep 2/3/4.
FDA approved Monovisc single-injection OA knee viscosupplement; DePuy Mitek U.S. marketing with $5M first-sale milestone. Class-3 approval.
AerCap definitive agreement to acquire AIG's ILFC for ~$5.4B cash+stock ($3B cash + ~97.6M AER shares). Acquirer M&A is class-2.
Solar equipment name rally in week of ITC extension / order buzz; no keep-2/3/4 company catalyst identified for session.
Phase 3 CRUISE-2: SFP met primary Hb and key secondary endpoints for iron deficiency in hemodialysis CKD; NDA path.
Vipshop Q4 earnings beat and raised 1Q guidance. Earnings/guidance, not keep 2/3/4.
Phase 1 SAD PRX002 Parkinson's: safe/tolerated; up to 96% mean reduction free serum alpha-synuclein after single dose (8-K 8.01).
Morgan Stanley Overweight initiation ($103 PT) plus media buzz. Analyst initiation, not keep 2/3/4.
Early LentiGlobin gene therapy data in beta-thalassemia: patients weaned off transfusions; hemoglobin production observed.
Novartis collaboration/license on bispecifics ($150M upfront, up to $2.41B milestones). Partnership/license (Item 1.01), not M&A of Xencor under keep-2.
Springleaf definitive agreement to acquire Citi's OneMain Financial for $4.25B cash. Acquirer M&A is class-2. Note: modern cik2symbol may map OneMain/LEAF reuse.
Q1 earnings beat (EPS $0.13 vs $0.08); 8-K Item 2.02 same day. Earnings, not keep 2/3/4.
Oil-price rebound / energy short-squeeze sector rally. Commodity/macro, not keep 2/3/4.
FDA lifted clinical holds on axalimogene filolisbac, ADXS-PSA, and ADXS-HER2 INDs; trials to resume with risk-mitigation. Class-3 clinical/regulatory.
Multi-year Samsung TouchSense/haptics license plus raised 2013 revenue guidance. Commercial license (Item 1.01), not keep 2/3/4.
IBM agreed to acquire Merge Healthcare for $7.13/share cash (~$1B).

Post Targacept/Catalyst reverse-merger listing under CBIO (completed ~Aug 20 with reverse split/pre-closing dividend). Mid-session float/listing noise after corporate action, not same-day M&A target, biotech trial, or tech breakthrough keep.
Baxter/Halozyme: EMA CHMP positive opinion for HyQvia (IGSC + rHuPH20) as immunodeficiency replacement therapy; class-3 regulatory success.
Amgen global collaboration/license for preclinical ADXS-NEO: $40M upfront plus $25M equity purchase and milestones. Partnership/license + minority stake, not keep 2/3/4.
A. Schulman publicly disclosed unsolicited $6.50/share half-cash/half-stock proposal to acquire Ferro (~$855M EV) after prior board rejection; confirmed M&A proposal/rumor keep.
NetSol signed >$100M NFS Ascent implementation/maintenance contract (Daimler Financial Services multi-country). Commercial software contract, not keep 2/3/4.
Rally after Google earnings-call mention that Etsy saw deep-linking traffic boost; amplified by short covering. Analyst/partner commentary, not keep 2/3/4.
Net1 announced ~$107.7M IFC equity subscription (~18% stake at $10.79). Financing/strategic equity investment, not keep 2/3/4.

Coca-Cola definitive strategic partnership: ~16.7% equity stake for ~$2.15B cash plus energy/non-energy brand swap and distribution alliance. Minority stake/partnership, not keep-class takeout/trial/breakthrough.
ITT Educational Q1 earnings beat (EPS/revenue vs consensus) with softer new-student enrollment decline; earnings reaction. Note cik2symbol may not match historical ITT Educational CIK.
Google agreed to invest in Himax Display subsidiary (initial ~6.3% preferred, option to ~14.8%) for LCOS capacity tied to Google Glass. Minority stake in sub / partnership investment, not keep 2/3/4.

FDA approved Orenitram (oral treprostinil) for PAH after prior complete responses; first oral prostacyclin analogue approval. Class-3 regulatory success; stock reacted Mon Dec 23 to Fri Dec 20 approval.
Closed ~$16.7M registered direct financing (~3.9M shares at $4.25) led by Adage (~19% stake) with T. Rowe; financing/stake build, not keep 2/3/4.
Fuel-cell peer rally spillover after Plug Power Walmart GenDrive momentum; no Ballard-specific M&A/trial/breakthrough same session. Sector momentum, not keep 2/3/4.
OPEC production-cut agreement; oil/E&P short-squeeze rally. Commodity/macro move, not keep 2/3/4.
Goodrich announced strong Blades 33H-1 Tuscaloosa Marine Shale well results (~1,270 BOE/d peak); operational well/commodity news with short cover, not keep 2/3/4.
Nusinersen met primary endpoint at interim Phase 3 ENDEAR in infantile-onset SMA; Biogen exercised option and paid $75M license fee. Class-3 biotech trial success.
Eldorado Resorts definitive agreement to acquire Isle of Capri for $23/share cash or 1.638 ERI shares (~$1.7B incl. debt, ~36% premium). Note cik2symbol may not match historical Isle of Capri CIK.
Continued fuel-cell rally on prior Walmart GenDrive expansion plus CEO profitability commentary; same-week 8-K was equity offering underwriting. Momentum/financing, not keep 2/3/4.
